messages.subject: physignal: sqrt(edg[tips])-error
parts:
Hello again^^,

Now I am so far to use physignal. And again an error message stops me :(
I compared the data with the plethspecies-example. The only difference I could figure out is that I have no branch lengths. Are they maybe neccessary? Before I had the warning that the "names do not match between tree and data matrix". But as it does not appear anymore, I assume I fixed it in the right manner and now the next error in the row is appearing.
Thank you once more for your help guys ;)
Best,
Peter

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] physignal: sqrt(edg[tips])-error
parts:
Peter,

 

Yes. For nearly all phylogenetic comparative methods, branch lengths are required. These models condition the data on the phylogeny to account for expected lack of independence. The degree of that expected non-independence is based on both topology, and time (branch lengths).

 

I suggest a careful reading of some recent conceptual papers in phylogenetic comparative methods. Most either state this explicitly, or discuss the phylogenetic covariance matrix in terms of its values and the branch lengths (or time).


Best,

 

Dean
